title: Long/Short asymmetry in BTC 1h breakout
reason: Directional LONG vs SHORT distributions differ, and the contrast persists out-of-sample; the breakout has now positive GROSS P&L on the deep BTC 1h history (unlike the 30-day Kraken sample).

observation.method: Temporal split 75/25 (train = first 50355 bars, test = last 16786 untouched). No parameter was optimized and no variant was selected on train.
observation.persistence: PERSISTE (signo LONG-SHORT positivo en train y test)

caveat: BTC had a strong structural uptrend over 2019-2026, so a long-biased breakout can capture directional beta rather than an idiosyncratic edge. The asymmetry may be TREND/BETA, not skill. Breakout dominates the random control only on real data; it must be contrasted against buy&hold and market regimes before any directional conclusion.

temporal_stability_followup.note: La ventaja LONG no es temporalmente estable: 6/12 folds trimestrales positivas, 3 vecindades negativas en 2021-2023, y la ventaja frente al control neutro no es consistente por ventana. Refuerza el caveat de que la asimetria puede ser beta direccional, no edge idiosincratico. No justifica pasar a BOTH ni a SHORT.

data_infrastructure.unit_audit: P&L/costs/MAE/MFE monetized by point_value; risk in $ == P&L in $ verified with point_value=50

next_step: H003: contrast LONG bias against buy&hold and market regimes (bull/bear/sideways) to separate directional beta from edge. Do NOT tune lookback/ATR/SMA/stops yet.
